# DataForSEO Keyword Trend by Region API

Get keyword interest split by subregion from an independent trends dataset.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/keywords_data/dataforseo_trends/subregion_interests/live` task schema (one task per call; send `{"tasks": [...]}` for several). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/keywords_data/dataforseo_trends/subregion_interests/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"keywords": ["running shoes"], "location_code": 2840}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint (one task per call). Fields used above:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `keywords` | List of keywords (up to 100 per call). |
| `location_code` | Location code, e.g. 2840 for the United States. |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/keywords_data/dataforseo_trends/subregion_interests/live/

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls are not charged.
